verdict.rationale: Cloudflare runs an official fleet of managed remote MCP servers, including the recommended Code Mode server covering the full Cloudflare API, with OAuth and bearer-token auth. It also documents per-agent onboarding guides and a Skills plugin that bundles these servers. Independent probes confirm a live keyless docs MCP server and a live OAuth-gated API MCP server that follows the MCP authorization spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
